research_scope: Ten base-game skills from PQ71-PQ80. Reward-slot and Ultimate-Finish semantics remain unresolved unless directly established.

duplicate_check.repository_search_note: All ten selected names returned no repository-search matches before insertion.

verification_audit.research_update: Batch 52 current-evidence pass completed for Dust Attack, Mighty Explosive Wave, and Dimensional Hole. All three are promoted to verified_current_scope using current Xenoverse 2-specific skill documentation plus independent/community corroboration. Reward probability and Ultimate-Finish-only semantics remain unresolved where not directly established.

records.name: Last Emperor
records.character_source: Frieza (1st Form); Frieza (Full Power); Golden Frieza; Golden Frieza (Supervillain)
records.skill_description: Fires a powerful purple energy wave without using Ki, but can only be used once when the user's health is low.
records.mechanics_notes: Current Xenoverse 2-specific evidence confirms Last Emperor as a 0-Ki Ki Blast Ultimate. It can be activated only at low health and only once per battle; independent discussion distinguishes it from Emperor's Death Beam and corroborates the no-Ki/low-health restriction. Repository skill-specific evidence retains the 21-hit beam note. PQ71 remains the acquisition endpoint; TP Medal Shop and 1st Form Frieza Partner Customization are documented in current skill provenance, but no exact reward probability or Ultimate-Finish-only requirement is inferred.

records.name: Burst Kamehameha
records.character_source: SSGSS Goku; Goku; Goku (Super Saiyan God); Goku (GT); Goku (Super Saiyan 4)
records.skill_description: Fires a Kamehameha and can consume additional Ki through a second input to extend the blast and deal more damage.
records.mechanics_notes: Current Xenoverse 2-specific evidence confirms Burst Kamehameha as a Ki Blast Super with 100 Ki initial activation; a second input during the connecting blast consumes another 100 Ki to prolong the multi-hit beam and deal additional damage. PQ72 is the current acquisition endpoint. Independent reward discussion confirms the skill can fail to drop even after completing PQ72, including an Ultimate Finish, so no Ultimate-Finish-only requirement or numeric drop probability is inferred.

records.name: Psychic Move
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 73 — Frieza's Siege Against Earth!
records.skill_description: Teleport behind the opponent and create a short-range shockwave that knocks them away.
records.mechanics_notes: Current Xenoverse 2-specific skill documentation classifies Psychic Move as a 300-Stamina Strike Evasive. It teleports the user behind the opponent and creates a short-range shockwave that deals approximately 5% damage and knocks the opponent away. Independent player reports support that PQ73 completion does not guarantee the skill and that repeated Ultimate Finishes can still fail to award it; no numeric drop probability or Ultimate-Finish-only gate is inferred.

records.name: Final Pose
records.skill_description: Strike a pose, then create a close-range shockwave that knocks the opponent away and temporarily increases normal attack power.
records.mechanics_notes: Current Xenoverse 2-specific skill documentation classifies Final Pose as a Power Up Evasive with 200 Stamina Used, a close-range shockwave/knockback effect, approximately 2% documented damage, and a temporary basic-attack increase lasting about 11.5–12 seconds. Older Xenoverse-era/general references list 300 Stamina; the current XV2-specific value is retained and the older value is preserved only as provenance context. PQ74 is the documented acquisition endpoint, while player reports identify the skill as a Recoome character drop; no guaranteed-drop or numeric probability is inferred.

records.name: Counter Burst
records.skill_description: Counters an incoming Ki Blast and returns a more powerful Ki Blast to the opponent.
records.mechanics_notes: Current Xenoverse 2-specific documentation confirms Counter Burst as a 100-Ki Ki Blast Super. It projects an energy shield that absorbs an incoming Ki Blast attack and returns a stronger Ki Blast counter; current skill data documents a six-hit counter projectile. PQ75 is the CaC acquisition endpoint, and current documentation also records Partner Customization availability for SSGSS Vegeta. Exact numeric stamina expenditure is not promoted because no sufficiently direct current source was established in this pass.

records.name: Warp Kamehameha
records.character_source: Goku; Goku (Super Saiyan God); SSGSS Goku; Goku (GT); Goku (Super Saiyan 4); Cell (Perfect); Gogeta (Super Saiyan 4); Goku Black; SSGSS Vegito; SSGSS Gogeta
records.skill_description: Charge a Kamehameha, teleport to the locked-on opponent, and fire at close range.
records.mechanics_notes: Current Xenoverse 2-specific skill documentation confirms Warp Kamehameha as a 400-Ki Ki Blast Ultimate with beam, teleport, tracking, long-range, and knockback characteristics. The user charges the Kamehameha, then teleports to the locked-on opponent and fires, with current documentation recording approximately 30% damage over 24 hits. PQ76 is the acquisition endpoint; additional Partner Customization availability is documented for multiple Goku-family presets. An older general Xenoverse reference lists 300 Ki, so that historical discrepancy is preserved rather than silently overwriting it. No numeric drop probability is inferred.

records.name: Ki Explosion
records.skill_description: Releases an explosive burst of Ki around the user.
records.mechanics_notes: Current Xenoverse 2-specific skill documentation confirms Ki Explosion as a 100-Ki Ki Blast Super. The user detonates Ki around themselves in a short-range purple explosion; holding the input prolongs the explosion and can consume additional Ki, with maintained documentation stating it can use up to four Ki bars. Bandai Namco's February 2017 DLC 2 announcement records the historical cost change from 200 Ki to 100 Ki, alongside increased damage and a shortened consecutive-use window. PQ77 — Parent and Child remains the acquisition endpoint. A recent GameFAQs report says the skill is awarded from PQ77 rather than a specific opponent and describes an Ultimate Finish route, but this community evidence is not promoted as a definitive hidden reward gate; exact probability and guarantee semantics remain unresolved.

records.name: Dust Attack
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 78 — Heated, Furious, Ultimate Battle
records.skill_description: A dust-based technique used to obscure or interfere with the opponent.
records.mechanics_notes: Current Xenoverse 2-specific documentation describes Dust Attack as a Super Skill that fires a burst of Ki in front of the user. The repository's prior research identifies PQ78 as its acquisition endpoint. Independent video evidence specifically demonstrates Dust Attack as the PQ78 skill reward, while GameFAQs reports document repeated PQ78 runs without a drop and uncertainty over whether an Ultimate Finish is required; therefore no numeric probability or hidden Ultimate-Finish gate is promoted.

records.name: Mighty Explosive Wave
records.skill_description: Unleashes an explosive Ki wave around the user.
records.mechanics_notes: Current Xenoverse 2-specific documentation classifies the base-game Mighty Explosive Wave as a 100-Ki Ki Blast Super, obtained from PQ79. It creates a short-range purple explosion around the user, documented at six hits and about 10% damage. The separate Jiren (Full Power) Evasive variation must not be conflated with this PQ79 Super. Community discussion independently describes the Super as a one-bar, non-extendable AOE with restand/combo-extension behavior; this player-reported behavior is retained as secondary mechanics evidence.

records.name: Dimensional Hole
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 80 — The Return of the Giant Ape-Fest!
records.skill_description: Creates a dimensional hole that absorbs a normal Ki Blast and sends a projectile back through a portal behind the opponent.
records.mechanics_notes: Current Xenoverse 2-specific documentation classifies Dimensional Hole as a 0-Ki Ki Blast Super and counter. The user creates a clear barrier that absorbs a Basic Ki Blast and returns a projectile through a portal behind the opponent; current skill-specific data documents about 15% damage and forward knockback. PQ80 — The Return of the Giant Ape-Fest remains the acquisition endpoint.
